entries.abstract: An independent Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the explicit three-dimensional polynomial map announced by Levent Alpöge in 2026. The project proves that its formal Jacobian determinant is the nonzero constant -2, verifies an explicit three-point fibre over the complex numbers, and derives the failure of injectivity required to refute the dimension-three Jacobian conjecture. The source formulas and proof scope are recorded explicitly; no claim is made about the still-open two-dimensional case.

entries.abstract: A self-contained version of the formal-conjectures formalization by Paul Lezeau and Dean Cureton. It disproves the generalized Jacobian conjecture over every nontrivial commutative ring using an explicit determinant-one polynomial self-map in three variables. The formal-conjectures formalisation remains the reference statement.
